title: mimi-mls: implement DR-15b safe_aad advertise+enforce
description: Implement decision mimid-1wgh.4.45 in mimi-mls: (1) identity.rs leaf app_data_dictionary gets a safe_aad ComponentsList (implemented Safe AAD components, currently none, plus a GREASE value); (2) Member add/commit/process (and Observer process) reject any new/updated leaf whose safe_aad / app_components lists (absent = empty) miss a non-GREASE component required by the GroupContext; (3) Member::create strictly decodes GroupContext safe_aad/app_components as ComponentsList (tls_deserialize_exact). Regression tests first (must fail before): hand-encoded §5 ComponentsList bytes in key_package_mls_rs.rs; mls-rs-built KeyPackages with and without a leaf safe_aad listing 0x0020 against a group requiring [0x0020]. Start after .4.7 lands (both edit mimi-mls).
notes: 2026-10-17 investigation: DR-15 premise wrong (ext-10 §5 L885-911 defines leaf safe_aad = supported Safe AAD components; GC safe_aad = required). No MUST broken today (§4.6 requires understanding, not advertising). Gaps: (1) leaf never advertises safe_aad (identity.rs:188-207); (2) no check of leaf lists vs GC required list anywhere (OpenMLS only toggles framing); (3) Member::create doesn't strictly decode GC safe_aad/app_components. Recommended corrected decision: reading B (always advertise; enforce like RFC 9420 §11.1; absent=empty; check in mimi-mls). Oracle: hand-encoded ComponentsList in key_package_mls_rs.rs; mls-rs-built KeyPackages with/without safe_aad against required [0x0020]. wg item filed.
